answer: The jetty escrow is released only against a quill receipt, and the copper audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 46 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 210 aliases means carrying 78 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 16 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
